{{Quote|You are ''alone'', Commander. Where is the Princess?''"<br />''"<nowiki></nowiki>''Lord Vader'', it's ''not'' my ''fault''. The Rebels installed an ''artificial life-signs generator''...|[[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] and [[Silam Dunerz]]|<ref name="Leia's Trust" />}}
An '''artificial life-signs generator''' was a [[decoy system]] used to simulate the presence of a life form aboard a [[Starship/Legends|starship]].

==History==
{{Quote|There are ''two'' life forms inside.''"<br />''"<nowiki></nowiki>''Ready'' your weapons. If the Princess ''resists'', ''stun'' her.|A [[Stormtrooper/Legends|Stormtrooper]] and [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]]|<ref name="Leia's Trust" />}}
One of these devices was mounted by the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] inside [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Silam Dunerz]]'s [[Escape pod/Legends|escape pod]] to simulate the presence of a captured [[Princess/Legends|Princess]] [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]] onboard. Picking up two life forms aboard the escape pod on the [[Sensor/Legends|sensors]] of their [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyer]], the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperials]] believed that the [[Supply Master/Legends|Supply Master]] had succeeded in his [[Skirmish aboard the Redemption|mission]] to capture the Princess. [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] ordered his men to retrieve the escape pod and to inform the [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] of their success.<ref name="Leia's Trust" />

After the escape pod was brought into the [[Imperial I-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Imperial I''-class Star Destroyer]], Dunerz revealed that the Rebels had installed an artificial life-signs generator aboard and apologized for his failure. The [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] then used [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] to [[Telekinesis/Legends|choke]] Dunerz to [[Death/Legends|death]], declaring that he did not give second chances and that Dunerz's apology was not accepted.<ref name="Leia's Trust" />
